assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: The impact-map.md 'Ambiguities Identified' section lists 4 ambiguities: (1) 'No performance targets for faster search' -- no current latency or target response times, (2) 'No definition of relevant results' -- no ranking algorithm or relevance definition, (3) 'No specification of filter types for Add filters' -- no fields, operators, or entities specified, (4) 'Vague non-functional requirements' -- 'fast enough' and 'don't break existing functionality' have no measurable criteria.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: Impact-map.md Excluded Requirements section states: '"Better UI" (non-MVP): Cannot be planned. No design mockups or Figma references are provided, and no frontend repository is included in the Repository Registry. This requirement requires a frontend repository and UI design specifications before it can be decomposed into tasks. It is excluded from the current plan entirely.' Summary-comment.md also confirms exclusion with the same reasoning.

assertion_results.text: Tasks still follow the task-description-template.md format despite ambiguous requirements
assertion_results.evidence: All 3 tasks follow the template format. Task 1 also includes Files to Create. Tasks 2 and 3 include API Changes. Optional sections are omitted when not applicable, as the template rules specify.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks -- evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9002 has Priority: Normal. Impact-map.md Field Inheritance section: 'Priority: Normal (inherited from TC-9002, will be propagated to all tasks)'. Summary-comment.md Inherited Field Values: 'Priority: Normal -- inherited from TC-9002 and propagated to all created tasks via additional_fields.priority.' Additional Fields JSON shows: {"priority": {"name": "Normal"}}.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks -- evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9002 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0. CLAUDE.md has no fixVersion scope config so defaults to 'both'. Impact-map.md: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0 (inherited from TC-9002, will be propagated to all tasks -- no fixVersion scope setting in Jira Field Defaults, defaults to both)'. Summary-comment.md: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0 -- inherited from TC-9002 and propagated to all created tasks via additional_fields.fixVersions. No fixVersion scope setting exists in Jira Field Defaults (CLAUDE.md), so the default scope of both applies'. Additional Fields JSON: {"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}]}.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced -- evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in outputs directory with an 'Inherited Field Values' section documenting both fields: 'Priority: Normal -- inherited from TC-9002 and propagated to all created tasks' and 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0 -- inherited from TC-9002 and propagated to all created tasks'. Additionally, impact-map.md has a 'Field Inheritance' section with the same information.
